label: IGH / MALT1
tumor_contexts: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
MALT1 encodes a signaling scaffold and paracaspase in antigen-receptor-associated NF-kappaB signaling.
The t(14;18) involving MALT1 increases MALT1 expression through IGH regulatory control and activates NF-kappaB-associated survival signaling. It is distinct from the t(14;18) involving BCL2.
